Scientists will discover how to teleport digital information.

This has implications that are rarely thought about. For example, telegraphs to the future. Let me explain...

To teleport information you get around the speed of light. The idea is to instantly have the information transferred between two points, not "there at the speed of light" but instantly. That comes with A LOT of baggage. For starters it would let you manipulate Time Dilation to create a device that exists not only in two locations at once, but two times at once, and communicate (instantly) between them.

Say we created a device that works by manipulating a pair of quantum entangled particles. The concept is when one is flipped, the other flips, instantly, faster than light, because there really aren't two particles but one particle existing in two places at once. So you create a device that can maintain this pairing separately over distance. Box "A" stays here on earth and Box "B" we put on a very fast, very long lasting rocket and send it out to space with a path that brings it home to earth 1000 years later.

Because Box "B" is traveling very fast in relation to Box A, due to relativity Box B experiences less time compared to Box A.

So, if the speed of Box B is fast enough, it could experience only 100 years in the 1000 "box A" years it takes to return home. So when Box B returns, it will be 1000 years in the future on Earth, but Box B will only have ages 100 years.

Now, normal Light based communication doesn't work as a Time-Phone because as the time dilation happens it stretches the signal. But our Boxes use quantum entanglement which communicate instantly, so cause and effect don't work properly and the "signal" isn't stretched. I'm not sure what would happen to the signal, but the in-flight paradox isn't the cool part, its what happens when the box returns home.

So in 100 years Box A time Box B is still traveling, yet when you communicate with Box B, because both particles are really the same particle, you talk to 100 year old Box B. 100 year old Box B, because of time dilation, has just returned to Earth, 1000 years later earth time. So now 100 year old Box A can talk to 100 year old Box B, but they are separated by 900 years here on Earth. Box B is now, basically, a telephone to 900 years in the future.

I'm no expert on Relativity but I'm willing to be that any system that uses FTL or Instant information transmission will be able to be used to do this. You can't talk back in time, not without moving the "Box B" faster than light.
